types.name: Identical pairs
types.description: A list of pairs of numbers, names or codes (4573821 – 4573821); asks how many pairs are exactly the same or which pair differs.

types.name: Address matching
types.description: A full address or record (name, house number, street, city, PIN) is given; asks which option or which listed entries are identical to it or to each other.

types.name: Date and city matching
types.description: A date written in one format (DD-MM-YYYY, MM/DD/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, or in words) must be matched with the same date in another format, or a city must be matched with its state or PIN code.

types.name: Matrix indexing
types.description: Letters placed in one or two matrices with numbered rows and columns; a letter is coded as row number then column number, and the question asks which set of numbers spells a word.

types.name: Centre code and roll number rules
types.description: Rules describe how a valid roll number, centre code or ID is built (letters, digits, length, hyphens); asks which code is valid or which rule a code breaks.

types.name: Name indexing
types.description: Names of people to be arranged as in an index or directory (surname first, then first name), or asks which name comes first or last.
